verdict.rationale: e-FRRO is an online government e-services portal, so publishing a programmatic API with an interactive reference is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence shows only a script-only application shell at the root and a 404 on the legacy entry path. Nothing shows an API reference, developer documentation, or runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
